sentences.Marie har nittiårsdag, og Johanna har in: It's Marie's ninetieth birthday, and Johanna has invited people to a big birthday party.
sentences.Nå lager hun eplekake mens Liv, en av tv: Now she's making apple cake while Liv, one of the twins, lays the table.
Liv puts a white tablecloth on the table.
The white tablecloth is very old.
sentences.Den har Marie fått av sin mor for lenge,: Marie got it from her mother a long, long time ago.
sentences.Liv setter små og store tallerkener på b: Liv puts small and large plates on the table.
The small plates are for the starter.
The large ones are for the main course.
She also fetches tall and short glasses.
sentences.De lave glassene er til vann, og de høye: The short glasses are for water, and the tall glasses are for mineral water or wine.
Her great-grandmother is fond of a glass of wine.
There are also flowers and candles on the table.
